description: Conditional, cyclic workflow graphs for Pi units.

scripts.coverage: npm run typecheck:tests && c8 --all --include=src/**/*.ts node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=${TEST_CONCURRENCY:-4} tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts tests/e2e/*.test.ts
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run typecheck:tests && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=${TEST_CONCURRENCY:-4} tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts tests/e2e/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run typecheck:tests && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/e2e/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run typecheck:tests && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=${TEST_CONCURRENCY:-4} tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run typecheck:tests && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=${TEST_CONCURRENCY:-4} tests/unit/*.test.ts

name: @centerforagenticai/pi-prompt-graph
